description: Permissions granted to every Radinus window. core:default covers the IPC calls. Hiding and showing are added because a Radinus window is never destroyed: leaving it hides it and coming back shows it again, which is what removed the crashes caused by rebuilding a window under a label still being torn down. Window creation itself stays in Rust rather than being granted to the frontend. The seven nomenclatures each have a list and a fiche window, named after their key, so the labels are matched by pattern rather than listed one by one — and the six statistics likewise, by statistics-*: listing statistics-category alone left the five others without a single permission, so nothing in them answered, not even their door (Fabrice, 26/07/2026). A window missing from this list is not a window with fewer rights, it is a window that cannot talk to Rust at all; windows::every_label is checked against this file by a test so the omission cannot happen again. dialog:allow-save opens the system's own "save as" box for the right-click export of the tables: only saving is granted, never opening or reading a file — the window asks where to write and Rust writes there, so nothing else on the disk is reachable from the frontend.
